names.note: Read out of doxologia.ro's line for 24 martie, «Sfântul Cuvios Zaharia».
Read out of saint.gr's line for 24 Μαρτίου, «Όσιος Ζαχαρίας», with the rank word left off.

Read out of the Ohrid Prologue's fifth heading for the Julian 24 March on pravoslavno.rs, „Преподобни Захарија.“, with the rank word Преподобни left off. The heading gives no epithet and no parentage — his father Carion is the body's first word — so the bare forename is what the source gives. The corpus keeps a second Zacharias on this same menologion day, the Faster of the Kyiv Caves, who holds no Serbian form, and this one is distinguished from him by `display_name` and by slug.

The heading of days.pravoslavie.ru’s name page 821, «Захария Отверстый, затворник», with the grade word left off. The by-name is the one its reading explains, the opened one, given him for his care of the poor and of strangers; this calendar does not call him the son of Carion and the day’s line gives him no by-name at all.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 24 марта ст. ст. — «Прп. Захарии монаха (IV).»

attestations.note: **This identification rests on the day, the century and the rank, and not on the name, and it is the one reading of this day that does.** The line is «Прп. Захарии монаха (IV).», name page 821 heads him «Захария Отверстый, затворник», and the reading, life700, is two sentences: he was called «отверстый», the opened one, for his particular care of the poor and of strangers; and the printed Menaion’s «преподобного отца нашего Захарии» is where **an erroneous split in the menologion between a Захария and a преподобный Захария монах came from** — the page says so itself. It names no Carion and no Egypt. The folder it is put on is the venerable monk Zacharias whom the Romanian, Greek and Serbian calendars all keep on this same menologion day and nowhere else, in the fourth century, with the same rank word; the line’s «(IV)» is the same century. One venerable monk of this name on this day in each of four calendars, and this source warning that the name has been split once already, is why this is a row and not a second folder. **If the author reads it otherwise the row belongs on a new folder and nowhere else, and nothing but this row would have to be undone.** The folder held no date; the century is added. The day page prints no hymn under his name. azbyka.ru was not read.

source.text: doxologia.ro, calendarul zilei pentru 24 martie — «Sfântul Cuvios Zaharia»
saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 24ης Μαρτίου — «Όσιος Ζαχαρίας»

attestations.note: «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 24 Μαρτίου εκάστου έτους.» The Greek line is bare — «Όσιος Ζαχαρίας», with no patronymic and no country — and what identifies it as this folder rather than the day's other Zacharias, the ascetic of the Lavra of the Caves at Kyiv, is that saint.gr's own page for it links «Όσιος Καρίων» beside him, and that its account is the story of the abba Zacharias of the Egyptian skete: Macarius and Moses coming to him for his words, and abba Isidore speaking at his death. The page gives no year.

feast.note: A SECOND SERBIAN DAY, and the same book keeps both. The Охридски пролог gives him a whole entry of his own on the Julian 24 March, „Преподобни Захарија.“, which is the day this row records and the day the Romanian and the Greek calendars keep him on too; and it gives him a second on the Julian 5 December, in the enumerated pair „Преподобни Карион и Захарија.“ — https://www.pravoslavno.rs/index.php?q=citanja&datum=2025-12-18&prolog=1, read 7 October 2026 — whose four lines are his father’s story and his own, and where it is he who answers the question who the true monk is. One attestation row per church is the schema, so BRIEF.md §4’s ruling applies: the second day is a note on this feast, naming the day and the heading, and he does not render on the Julian 5 December. NOTHING ELSE UNDER THIS KEY WAS CHANGED — same day, same month, same calendar, same source, same note — which is the whole of what `replace_venerated` is sanctioned for.

source.text: Православни подсетник (pravoslavno.rs), Охридски пролог за 06.04.2026 (24. март ст. ст.) — „Преподобни Захарија.“

attestations.note: The day's fifth and last entry, on the same menologion day the Romanian and the Greek already keep in this folder, and the same monk: the son of Carion the Egyptian, taken into the desert by his father because his mother could not feed him, younger than many of the elders of Scetis and given greater gifts than many of them, and dead young. The entry gives no year, no century and no reign, so this folder's `dates` object stays empty, as it was. It carries two sayings, one answering a Macarius on who is a true monk and one answering Abba Moses with the camelaucion trodden underfoot; both are Bishop Nikolai's text and are paraphrased in the life rather than copied. `moses-the-ethiopian` is already `related` here in both directions, which is where this corpus has read that Abba Moses, and no row was added. **The Macarius of the first saying was not identified**: the corpus keeps many, the entry gives him no by-name, and naming one would be a guess, so the life leaves him as the page leaves him. The stored form is the bare forename, because Преподобни is the rank and the heading carries nothing else. The Prologue prints no troparion and no kontakion.

death.note: The century days.pravoslavie.ru closes the line with for 24 марта ст. ст., «(IV)». The folder held no date at all: neither doxologia nor saint.gr nor the Prologue gave one.
